answer: A newcomer joins the Falcon Exchange: it must teach one real skill to a stranger from an unrelated trade, and that stranger's own community certifies whether the lesson truly worked. Each certified exchange adds one marble to a public kernel of proven teaching, and privileges grow only as the marbles come from different trades and different teachers. A Sybil farm fails because its fakes cannot teach dozens of distinct skills convincingly, and identical lessons expose the cluster at once. One failed exchange sends the agent back to the kernel of basics alone.
